intro.en: Ahmad tells Abdullah about a sick friend and about waste buried in their country by factories abroad. Read it and notice how they worry about their people.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein Ahmad Abdullah ko ek beemar dost ke baare mein aur mulk mein dafn kiye gaye kooday ke baare mein batata hai. Parhein aur dekhein ke woh apni qaum ke liye kaise fikarmand hain.
intro.ar: يُحَدِّثُ أَحْمَدُ عَبْدَ اللهِ عَنْ صَديقٍ مَريضٍ وَعَنْ نُفاياتٍ دُفِنَتْ في بِلادِهِمْ مِنْ مَصانِعَ في الخارِجِ. اِقْرَأْ وَلاحِظْ كَيْفَ يَقْلَقانِ عَلى شَعْبِهِما.

dialogue.ar: أَنا قادِمٌ مِنَ المُسْتَشْفى. كُنْتُ أَزورُ ابْنَ صَديقي صالِحاً؛ إِنَّهُ مُصابٌ بِالسَّرَطان.
dialogue.tr: anā qādimun mina l-mustashfā. kuntu azūru bna ṣadīqī ṣāliḥan; innahu muṣābun bi-s-saraṭān
dialogue.en: I am coming from the hospital. I was visiting my friend's son Salih; he has cancer.
dialogue.ur: Main hospital se aa raha hoon. Main apne dost ke bete Salih ki iyadat ko gaya tha; use cancer hai.

dialogue.ar: وَكَيْفَ حالَتُهُ الآن؟
dialogue.tr: wa kayfa ḥālatuhu l-ān?
dialogue.en: And how is his condition now?
dialogue.ur: Ab uski haalat kaisi hai?

dialogue.ar: اِنْتَشَرَ المَرَضُ في جِسْمِهِ.
dialogue.tr: intashara l-maraḍu fī jismihi
dialogue.en: The disease has spread in his body.
dialogue.ur: Bimari uske jism mein phail gayi hai.

dialogue.ar: لا حَوْلَ وَلا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّه.
dialogue.tr: lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā bi-llāh
dialogue.en: There is no power and no might except with Allah.
dialogue.ur: Allah ke siwa na koi taqat hai na quwwat.

dialogue.ar: كَثُرَتْ أَمْراضُ السَّرَطانِ في بَلَدِنا، وَهَذا الأَمْرُ يُحَيِّرُني كَثيراً.
dialogue.tr: kathurat amrāḍu s-saraṭāni fī baladinā, wa hādhā l-amru yuḥayyirunī kathīran
dialogue.en: Cancer diseases have become many in our country, and this matter puzzles me a lot.
dialogue.ur: Hamare mulk mein cancer ki bimariyan bohat badh gayi hain, aur yeh baat mujhe bohat hairan karti hai.

dialogue.ar: صَدَقْتَ، فَقَدْ ماتَ في مَدينَتِنا وَحْدَها عَدَدٌ كَبيرٌ خِلالَ شَهْرٍ واحِد.
dialogue.tr: ṣadaqta, faqad māta fī madīnatinā waḥdahā ʿadadun kabīrun khilāla shahrin wāḥid
dialogue.en: You are right; in our city alone a large number died within one month.
dialogue.ur: Aap sach kehte hain; sirf hamare shehar mein ek mahine mein bohat se log faut hue.

dialogue.ar: ذَكَرَتِ الصُّحُفُ أَنَّ هُناكَ نُفاياتٍ مَدْفونَةً في بِلادِنا.
dialogue.tr: dhakarati ṣ-ṣuḥufu anna hunāka nufāyātin madfūnatan fī bilādinā
dialogue.en: The newspapers mentioned that there is waste buried in our country.
dialogue.ur: Akhbaron ne zikr kiya ke hamare mulk mein kooday dafn kiye gaye hain.

dialogue.ar: مِنْ أَيْنَ جاءَتْ تِلْكَ النُّفاياتُ؟
dialogue.tr: min ayna jāʾat tilka n-nufāyāt?
dialogue.en: Where did that waste come from?
dialogue.ur: Woh kooday kahan se aaya?

dialogue.ar: أُحْضِرَتْ مِنْ بَعْضِ الدُّوَلِ الصِّناعِيَّةِ؛ لِتُدْفَنَ في بِلادِنا.
dialogue.tr: uḥḍirat min baʿḍi d-duwali ṣ-ṣināʿiyyah; li-tudfana fī bilādinā
dialogue.en: It was brought from some industrial countries to be buried in our country.
dialogue.ur: Kuch sanati mulkon se laya gaya taake hamare mulk mein dafn kiya jaye.

dialogue.ar: وَلِماذا لا تُدْفَنُ في تِلْكَ البِلادِ الصِّناعِيَّةِ؟! أَلَيْسَ لَهُمْ أَرْضٌ مِثْلُنا؟!
dialogue.tr: wa li-mādhā lā tudfanu fī tilka l-bilādi ṣ-ṣināʿiyyah?! a-laysa lahum arḍun mithluna?!
dialogue.en: And why is it not buried in those industrial countries? Don't they have land like us?
dialogue.ur: Woh un sanati mulkon mein kyun dafn nahin hota? Kya unke paas hamari tarah zameen nahin?

dialogue.ar: بَلى، لَهُمْ أَرْضٌ مِثْلُنا، وَلكِنْ لَدَيْهِمْ مُنَظَّماتٌ لا تَسْمَحُ بِتَلَوُّثِ البيئَةِ، وَهُمْ يَخافونَ عَلى شُعوبِهِمْ.
dialogue.tr: balā, lahum arḍun mithlunā, wa-lākin ladayhim munaẓẓamātun lā tasmaḥu bi-talawwuthi l-bīʾah, wa hum yakhāfūna ʿalā shuʿūbihim
dialogue.en: Yes, they have land like us, but they have organizations that do not allow pollution of the environment, and they fear for their peoples.
dialogue.ur: Haan, unke paas hamari jaisi zameen hai, lekin unke paas aisi tanzeemein hain jo mahol ko ganda karne ki ijazat nahin deteen, aur woh apni qaumon ke liye fikarmand hain.

dialogue.ar: وَلِماذا لا نَخافُ عَلى شُعوبِنا مِثْلَهُمْ، وَتَكونُ لَنا مُنَظَّماتٌ مِثْلُ مُنَظَّماتِهِمْ؟!
dialogue.tr: wa li-mādhā lā nakhāfu ʿalā shuʿūbinā mithlahum, wa takūnu lanā munaẓẓamātun mithlu munaẓẓamātihim?!
dialogue.en: And why do we not fear for our peoples like them, and have organizations like theirs?
dialogue.ur: Hum apni qaumon ke liye unki tarah fikarmand kyun nahin, aur hamari tanzeemein unki tarah kyun nahin?

dialogue.ar: هَذا ما يَجِبُ عَمَلُهُ.
dialogue.tr: hādhā mā yajibu ʿamaluh
dialogue.en: This is what must be done.
dialogue.ur: Yehi karna zaroori hai.

vocab.ur: kisi ke liye fikarmand hota hai

q.en: What is Ahmad's friend's son suffering from?
q.ur: Ahmad ke dost ke bete ko kya bimari hai?
q.ar: بِأَيِّ مَرَضٍ يُعاني اِبْنُ صَديقِ أَحْمَدَ؟

q.en: What did the newspapers mention?
q.ur: Akhbaron ne kya zikr kiya?

q.en: Where did the waste come from?
q.ur: Yeh kooday kahan se aaya?

q.en: What does «لا حَوْلَ وَلا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّه» show here?
q.ur: «لا حَوْلَ وَلا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّه» yahan kya zahir karta hai?
q.ar: عَلامَ تَدُلُّ عِبارَةُ «لا حَوْلَ وَلا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّه» هُنا؟

options: Patience on hearing sad news / Gham ki khabar par sabr

q.en: What does «الأَمْرُ يُحَيِّرُني» mean?
q.ur: «الأَمْرُ يُحَيِّرُني» ka matlab?

options: This matter puzzles me / Yeh baat mujhe hairan karti hai
I like this matter / Mujhe yeh pasand hai
I am hungry / Mujhe bhook hai
options_ar: هذا الأَمْرُ يَجْعَلُني في دَهْشَةٍ وَاِرْتِباكٍ

title.ur: Aawazein: Noon ka Meem ban jana

intro.en: When a silent noon (نْ) or tanween comes before the letter ب (ba), it is pronounced like م (meem). Example: أَنْبَتَ is said 'ambata'. Listen to the Qur'an examples in the book and notice it.
intro.ur: Jab noon saakin (نْ) ya tanween harf ب se pehle aaye to woh م (meem) ki tarah parha jata hai. Misal: أَنْبَتَ ko 'ambata' parhte hain. Kitab ki Qur'ani misalon ko sun kar dekhein.
intro.ar: إِذا جاءَتْ نونٌ ساكِنَةٌ أَوْ تَنْوينٌ قَبْلَ حَرْفِ الباءِ فَإِنَّها تُنْطَقُ ميماً. مِثالٌ: «أَنْبَتَ» تُنْطَقُ «أَمْبَتَ». اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى أَمْثِلَةِ القُرْآنِ في الكِتابِ وَلاحِظْ ذلِكَ.

q.en: Before which letter does a silent noon turn into meem?
q.ur: Noon saakin kis harf se pehle meem ban jata hai?
q.ar: قَبْلَ أَيِّ حَرْفٍ تَنْقَلِبُ النّونُ السّاكِنَةُ ميماً؟

q.en: Which also turns into meem before ب?
q.ur: Ba se pehle aur kya meem ban jata hai?
q.ar: ماذا يَنْقَلِبُ أَيْضاً ميماً قَبْلَ الباءِ؟

q.en: How is «مِنْ بَعْد» pronounced when the noon turns into meem?
q.ur: «مِنْ بَعْد» ko noon meem banne par kaise parhte hain?
q.ar: كَيْفَ تُنْطَقُ «مِنْ بَعْد» عِنْدَ قَلْبِ النّونِ ميماً؟

q.en: The rule in short is:
q.ur: Qaida mukhtasar:

intro.en: If a verb has a weak letter (و or ي or ى) at its start, middle or end, that letter is dropped when making the command. Example: قالَ (he said) becomes قُلْ (say!). Another: وَعَدَ becomes عِدْ (promise!).
intro.ur: Agar fe'l mein harf-e-illat (و، ي، ى) shuru, beech ya akhir mein ho to hukm banate waqt woh harf gir jata hai. Misal: قالَ (usne kaha) se قُلْ (kaho!). Aur وَعَدَ se عِدْ (wada karo!).
intro.ar: إِذا كانَ في الفِعْلِ حَرْفُ عِلَّةٍ (و أَوْ ي أَوْ ى) في أَوَّلِهِ أَوْ وَسَطِهِ أَوْ آخِرِهِ، يُحْذَفُ عِنْدَ صِياغَةِ الأَمْرِ. مِثالٌ: «قالَ» تُصْبِحُ «قُلْ»، وَ«وَعَدَ» تُصْبِحُ «عِدْ».

q.en: What is the command of قالَ?
q.ur: قالَ ka hukm kya hai?

q.en: What is the command of نامَ?
q.ur: نامَ ka hukm?

q.en: What is the command of قَضى?
q.ur: قَضى ka hukm?

q.en: In a command, the weak letter is...
q.ur: Hukm mein harf-e-illat...
q.ar: ماذا يَحْدُثُ لِحَرْفِ العِلَّةِ في فِعْلِ الأَمْرِ؟

options: moved to the end / akhir mein jata hai

q.en: What is the command of وَصَفَ?
q.ur: وَصَفَ ka hukm?

intro.en: Listen to a news item about a city that bought new buses to reduce pollution, then answer questions. After that, practise asking your partner about the environment.
intro.ur: Ek khabar sunein jis mein ek shehar ne mahol ki hifazat ke liye nayi bussein khareedeen, phir sawalon ke jawab dein. Uske baad apne saathi se mahol ke baare mein sawal jawab karein.
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى خَبَرٍ عَنْ مَدينَةٍ اِشْتَرَتْ حافِلاتٍ جَديدَةً لِتَقْليلِ التَّلَوُّثِ، ثُمَّ أَجِبْ عَنِ الأَسْئِلَةِ. بَعْدَ ذلِكَ اِسْأَلْ زَميلَكَ عَنِ البيئَةِ.

q.en: Which country is the news about?
q.ur: Khabar kis mulk ki hai?

q.en: What problem does the city face?
q.ur: Shehar ko kya masla hai?

q.en: How many buses did the council buy?
q.ur: Council ne kitni bussein khareedeen?

q.en: What do the new buses run on?
q.ur: Nayi bussein kis par chalti hain?

q.en: How do you ask a partner: do you live in the city or the countryside?
q.ur: Saathi se poochein: shehar mein rehte ho ya dehaat mein?
q.ar: كَيْفَ تَسْأَلُ زَميلَكَ: هَلْ تَعيشُ في المَدينَةِ أَمْ في الرِّيفِ؟

options: هَلْ تَعيشُ في المَدينَةِ أَمْ في الرِّيف؟

intro.en: This reading explains four kinds of pollution: air, water, soil and noise. For each, it gives the cause and the harm to people, animals and plants.
intro.ur: Is parhai mein aloodgi ki chaar qismein hain: hawa, paani, mitti aur shor. Har ek ka sabab aur insaan, janwar aur paudhon ko nuqsan bataya gaya hai.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلقِراءَةِ يَشْرَحُ أَرْبَعَةَ أَنْواعٍ مِنَ التَّلَوُّثِ: الهَواءِ وَالماءِ وَالتُّرْبَةِ وَالضَّوْضاءِ. وَيَذْكُرُ لِكُلِّ نَوْعٍ سَبَبَهُ وَضَرَرَهُ عَلى الإِنْسانِ وَالحَيَوانِ وَالنَّباتِ.

dialogue.ar: هُناكَ صُوَرٌ عَديدَةٌ لِتَلَوُّثِ البيئَةِ، أَهَمُّها: تَلَوُّثُ الهَواءِ، وَتَلَوُّثُ الماءِ، وَتَلَوُّثُ التُّرْبَةِ، وَالضَّوْضاءُ.
dialogue.tr: hunāka ṣuwarun ʿadīda li-talawwuthi l-bīʾa, ahammuhā: talawwuthu l-hawāʾ, wa talawwuthu l-māʾ, wa talawwuthu t-turba, wa ḍ-ḍawḍāʾ
dialogue.en: There are many forms of environmental pollution; the most important are air pollution, water pollution, soil pollution and noise.
dialogue.ur: Mahol ki aloodgi ki kai soorten hain; sab se aham: hawa, paani, mitti ki aloodgi aur shor.

dialogue.ar: تَلَوُّثُ الهَواءِ: الهَواءُ الَّذي لا رائِحَةَ لَهُ يُصْبِحُ هَواءً لَهُ رائِحَةٌ، وَلَهُ لَوْنٌ أَيْضاً.
dialogue.tr: talawwuthu l-hawāʾ: al-hawāʾu lladhī lā rāʾiḥata lahu yuṣbiḥu hawāʾan lahu rāʾiḥa, wa lahu lawnun ayḍan
dialogue.en: Air pollution: air that has no smell becomes air with a smell, and it has a colour too.
dialogue.ur: Hawa ki aloodgi: jis hawa ki koi bu nahin hoti woh bu wali ho jati hai, aur uska rang bhi hota hai.

dialogue.ar: وَالسَّبَبُ في هَذا التَّلَوُّثِ إِحْراقُ النِّفْطِ، بِسَبَبِ مُحَرِّكاتِ السَّيّاراتِ وَغَيْرِها.
dialogue.tr: wa s-sababu fī hādhā t-talawwuthi iḥrāqu n-nifṭ, bi-sababi muḥarrikāti s-sayyārāti wa ghayrihā
dialogue.en: The cause of this pollution is burning oil, because of car engines and other things.
dialogue.ur: Is aloodgi ka sabab tel ka jalna hai, gaariyon ke engine waghera ki wajah se.

dialogue.ar: وَيَضُرُّ تَلَوُّثُ الهَواءِ بِصِحَّةِ الإِنْسانِ؛ فَيُؤَدّي إِلى التِهابِ العُيونِ وَالرِّئَةِ. وَيُسَبِّبُ مَوْتَ الحَيَوانِ وَالنَّباتِ.
dialogue.tr: wa yaḍurru talawwuthu l-hawāʾi bi-ṣiḥḥati l-insān; fa-yuʾaddī ilā ltihābi l-ʿuyūni wa r-riʾa. wa yusabbibu mawta l-ḥayawāni wa n-nabāt
dialogue.en: Air pollution harms human health; it leads to inflammation of the eyes and lungs. It also causes the death of animals and plants.
dialogue.ur: Hawa ki aloodgi insaan ki sehat ko nuqsan deti hai; aankhon aur phephron ki sozish hoti hai. Isse janwar aur paudhe bhi mar jate hain.

dialogue.ar: تَلَوُّثُ الماءِ: يُؤَدّي إِلى تَقْليلِ الماءِ النَّقِيِّ العَذْبِ، الَّذي يَسْتَعْمِلُهُ الإِنْسانُ في الشُّرْبِ وَالنَّظافَةِ.
dialogue.tr: talawwuthu l-māʾ: yuʾaddī ilā taqlīli l-māʾi n-naqiyyi l-ʿadhb, alladhī yastaʿmiluhu l-insānu fi sh-shurbi wa n-naẓāfa
dialogue.en: Water pollution: it reduces clean, sweet water that people use for drinking and cleaning.
dialogue.ur: Paani ki aloodgi: saaf meetha paani kam ho jata hai jo insaan peene aur safai mein istemal karta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَالسَّبَبُ رَمْيُ المَوادِّ الكيماوِيَّةِ وَالنُّفاياتِ الحَيَوانِيَّةِ وَالنَّباتِيَّةِ وَمِياهِ الصَّرْفِ الصِّحِّيِّ في البِحارِ وَالأَنْهارِ وَالآبار.
dialogue.tr: wa s-sababu ramyu l-mawāddi l-kīmāwiyya wa n-nufāyāti l-ḥayawāniyya wa n-nabātiyya wa miyāhi ṣ-ṣarfi ṣ-ṣiḥḥiyyi fī l-biḥāri wa l-anhāri wa l-ābār
dialogue.en: The cause is throwing chemicals, animal and plant waste and sewage water into seas, rivers and wells.
dialogue.ur: Sabab yeh hai ke keemiyai maaddey, janwaron aur paudhon ka kachra aur gandagi ka paani samundar, nadiyon aur kunon mein phenka jata hai.

dialogue.ar: تَلَوُّثُ التُّرْبَةِ: يُتْلِفُ هَذا النَّوْعُ التُّرْبَةَ الجَيِّدَةَ، وَيُؤَدّي إِلى فَقْدِ مِساحَةٍ مِنَ الأَرْضِ الَّتي يُزْرَعُ فيها النَّباتُ لِغِذاءِ الإِنْسانِ وَالحَيَوان.
dialogue.tr: talawwuthu t-turba: yutlifu hādhā n-nawʿu t-turbata l-jayyida, wa yuʾaddī ilā faqdi misāḥatin mina l-arḍi llatī yuzraʿu fīhā n-nabātu li-ghidhāʾi l-insāni wa l-ḥayawān
dialogue.en: Soil pollution: this type spoils good soil and leads to losing land where plants are grown as food for people and animals.
dialogue.ur: Mitti ki aloodgi: yeh achhi mitti ko kharab karti hai aur woh zameen kam ho jati hai jis mein insaan aur janwar ki ghiza ke liye fasal ugai jati hai.

dialogue.ar: الضَّوْضاءُ: تَكْثُرُ الضَّوْضاءُ في المُدُنِ، وَسَبَبُها وَسائِلُ النَّقْلِ مِنْ طائِراتٍ وَحافِلاتٍ وَقِطاراتٍ وَسَيّاراتٍ. وَتُؤَدّي الضَّوْضاءُ إِلى ضَعْفِ السَّمْعِ وَالقَلَق.
dialogue.tr: aḍ-ḍawḍāʾ: takthuru ḍ-ḍawḍāʾu fī l-mudun, wa sababuhā wasāʾilu n-naqli min ṭāʾirātin wa ḥāfilātin wa qiṭārātin wa sayyārāt. wa tuʾaddī ḍ-ḍawḍāʾu ilā ḍaʿfi s-samʿi wa l-qalaq
dialogue.en: Noise: noise is common in cities, caused by transport such as planes, buses, trains and cars. Noise leads to weak hearing and anxiety.
dialogue.ur: Shor: shehron mein shor bohat hota hai, sabab sawariyan hain jaise jahaz, bus, train aur gaariyan. Shor se sunne ki kamzori aur bechaini hoti hai.

q.en: Which is one of the types mentioned?
q.ur: Inmein se kaun si qism zikr hui?
q.ar: أَيُّ نَوْعٍ مِنْ أَنْواعِ التَّلَوُّثِ ذُكِرَ في النَّصِّ؟

q.en: What is a cause of air pollution?
q.ur: Hawa ki aloodgi ka sabab?

q.en: Water pollution is caused by...
q.ur: Paani ki aloodgi ka sabab...

q.en: Noise (الضَّوْضاء) leads to...
q.ur: Shor ka nateeja...

q.en: Soil pollution causes...
q.ur: Mitti ki aloodgi se...

intro.en: A noun or verb in the 'raf' state' shows it with a sign at its end. There are four signs: the damma, the alif, the waw and the staying of the noon. Which one depends on the word type.
intro.ur: Ism ya fe'l jab marfoo' hota hai to akhir mein nishani hoti hai. Chaar nishaniyan: zamma, alif, waw aur noon ka sabit rehna. Kaun si ho, yeh lafz ki qism par hai.
intro.ar: يَظْهَرُ رَفْعُ الاِسْمِ أَوِ الفِعْلِ بِعَلامَةٍ في آخِرِهِ. لِلرَّفْعِ أَرْبَعُ عَلاماتٍ: الضَّمَّةُ وَالأَلِفُ وَالواوُ وَثُبوتُ النّونِ، وَتَخْتَلِفُ بِاخْتِلافِ نَوْعِ الكَلِمَةِ.

q.ur: Mufrad ism jaise أَحْمَدُ ki nishani:
q.ar: ما عَلامَةُ رَفْعِ الاِسْمِ المُفْرَدِ مِثْلِ «أَحْمَدُ»؟

q.en: The sign of raf' for the dual مَسْجِدانِ is:
q.ur: Muthanna مَسْجِدانِ ki nishani:

q.en: The sign of raf' for the five verbs like يَجْلِسونَ is:
q.ur: الأَفْعال الخَمْسَة jaise يَجْلِسونَ ki nishani:
q.ar: ما عَلامَةُ رَفْعِ الأَفْعالِ الخَمْسَةِ مِثْلِ «يَجْلِسونَ»؟

q.en: Which five-nouns example is shown?
q.ur: Asma-e-khamsa ki kaun si misal hai?

title.en: Who protects the environment? Who harms it?
title.ur: Mahol ki hifazat kaun karta hai? Kaun bigadta hai?

intro.en: Badr invites Amir to join an organization for protecting the environment. They go on a tour and see people who harm nature and others who protect it.
intro.ur: Badr Amir ko mahol ki hifazat ki tanzeem mein shamil hone ko kehta hai. Dauray mein woh kuch log dekhte hain jo mahol bigadte hain aur kuch jo bachate hain.
intro.ar: يَدْعو بَدْرٌ عامِراً إِلى الاِنْضِمامِ لِمُنَظَّمَةٍ تَحْمي البيئَةَ. يَقومانِ بِجَوْلَةٍ فَيَرَيانِ أُناساً يُؤْذونَ الطَّبيعَةَ وَآخَرينَ يَحْمونَها.

dialogue.ar: أَنْشَأْنا مُنَظَّمَةً لِحِمايَةِ البيئَةِ. هَلْ تَشْتَرِكُ مَعَنا؟
dialogue.tr: anshaʾnā munaẓẓamatan li-ḥimāyati l-bīʾa. hal tashtariku maʿanā?
dialogue.en: We have founded an organization to protect the environment. Will you join us?
dialogue.ur: Humne mahol ki hifazat ki ek tanzeem banayi hai. Kya aap hamare saath shamil honge?

dialogue.ar: بِالطَّبْعِ، فَبِلادُنا تَحْتاجُ إِلى مِثْلِ هَذِهِ المُنَظَّمَةِ.
dialogue.tr: bi-ṭ-ṭabʿ, fa-bilādunā taḥtāju ilā mithli hādhihi l-munaẓẓama
dialogue.en: Of course, our country needs an organization like this.
dialogue.ur: Zaroor, hamare mulk ko aisi tanzeem ki zaroorat hai.

dialogue.ar: سَنَقومُ غَداً -إِنْ شاءَ اللهُ- بِجَوْلَةٍ؛ لِنَرى ما يَفْعَلُهُ النّاسُ بِالبيئَةِ في بِلادِنا. سَتَكونُ الجَوْلَةُ بِالطّائِرَةِ. أَرْجو أَنْ تَكونَ مَعَنا.
dialogue.tr: sanaqūmu ghadan -in shāʾa llāhu- bi-jawla; li-narā mā yafʿaluhu n-nāsu bi-l-bīʾa fī bilādinā. sa-takūnu l-jawlatu bi-ṭ-ṭāʾira. arjū an takūna maʿanā
dialogue.en: Tomorrow, God willing, we will go on a tour to see what people do to the environment in our country. The tour will be by plane. I hope you will be with us.
dialogue.ur: Kal, insha'Allah, hum ek daura karenge taake dekhein ke log hamare mulk mein mahol ke saath kya karte hain. Daura jahaz se hoga. Umeed hai aap hamare saath honge.

dialogue.ar: هَذِهِ فِكْرَةٌ طَيِّبَةٌ. سَأَكونُ مَعَكُمْ.
dialogue.tr: hādhihi fikratun ṭayyiba. sa-akūnu maʿakum
dialogue.en: This is a good idea. I will be with you.
dialogue.ur: Yeh achhi soch hai. Main aap ke saath hoon ga.

dialogue.ar: اُنْظُروا إِلى هَؤُلاءِ النّاسِ. إِنَّهُمْ يُفْسِدونَ البيئَةَ!
dialogue.tr: unẓurū ilā hāʾulāʾi n-nās. innahum yufsidūna l-bīʾa!
dialogue.en: Look at these people. They are harming the environment!
dialogue.ur: In logon ko dekho. Yeh mahol bigad rahe hain!

dialogue.ar: هَؤُلاءِ يَحْرِقونَ الغاباتِ، وَأُولَئِكَ يَقْتُلونَ الحَيَواناتِ!
dialogue.tr: hāʾulāʾi yaḥriqūna l-ghābāt, wa ulāʾika yaqtulūna l-ḥayawānāt!
dialogue.en: These burn the forests, and those kill the animals!
dialogue.ur: Yeh jungle jala rahe hain, aur woh janwar maar rahe hain!

dialogue.ar: وَهَؤُلاءِ يُلْقونَ النُّفاياتِ في البَرِّ، وَأُولَئِكَ يُلْقونَها في البَحْرِ.
dialogue.tr: wa hāʾulāʾi yulqūna n-nufāyāti fi l-barr, wa ulāʾika yulqūnahā fi l-baḥr
dialogue.en: And these throw waste on land, and those throw it in the sea.
dialogue.ur: Aur yeh kooday khushki par phenk rahe hain, aur woh samundar mein.

dialogue.ar: لِماذا يُفْسِدُ هَؤُلاءِ النّاسُ البيئَةَ؟! ظَهَرَ الفَسادُ في البَرِّ وَالبَحْرِ.
dialogue.tr: li-mādhā yufsidu hāʾulāʾi n-nāsu l-bīʾa?! ẓahara l-fasādu fi l-barri wa l-baḥr
dialogue.en: Why do these people harm the environment? Corruption has appeared on land and sea.
dialogue.ur: Yeh log mahol kyun bigad rahe hain? Khushki aur tari mein fasad zahir ho gaya.

dialogue.ar: اُنْظُرْ إِلى هَؤُلاءِ النّاسِ، إِنَّهُمْ يُحافِظونَ عَلى البيئَةِ.
dialogue.tr: unẓur ilā hāʾulāʾi n-nās, innahum yuḥāfiẓūna ʿalā l-bīʾa
dialogue.en: Look at these people; they are protecting the environment.
dialogue.ur: In logon ko dekho, yeh mahol ki hifazat kar rahe hain.

dialogue.ar: صَدَقْتَ، فَهُمْ يَزْرَعونَ الأَرْضَ؛ لِإيقافِ التَّصَحُّرِ.
dialogue.tr: ṣadaqt, fa-hum yazraʿūna l-arḍ; li-īqāfi t-taṣaḥḥur
dialogue.en: You are right, they plant the land to stop desertification.
dialogue.ur: Aap sach kehte hain, yeh zameen ugate hain taake registan banna ruk jaye.

dialogue.ar: وَأُولَئِكَ يُحافِظونَ عَلى الحَيَواناتِ النّادِرَةِ؛ حَتّى لا تَنْقَرِضَ.
dialogue.tr: wa ulāʾika yuḥāfiẓūna ʿalā l-ḥayawānāti n-nādira; ḥattā lā tanqariḍ
dialogue.en: And those protect rare animals so they do not become extinct.
dialogue.ur: Aur woh nayab janwaron ki hifazat karte hain taake woh khatam na ho jayein.

dialogue.ar: أَنا مَسْرورٌ جِدّاً؛ فَما يَقومُ بِهِ هَؤُلاءِ النّاسُ عَمَلٌ طَيِّبٌ.
dialogue.tr: anā masrūrun jiddan; fa-mā yaqūmu bihi hāʾulāʾi n-nāsu ʿamalun ṭayyib
dialogue.en: I am very pleased; what these people do is a good deed.
dialogue.ur: Main bohat khush hoon; in logon ka kaam achha kaam hai.

dialogue.ar: نُريدُ بيئَةً خالِيَةً مِنَ التَّلَوُّثِ.
dialogue.tr: nurīdu bīʾatan khāliyatan mina t-talawwuth
dialogue.en: We want an environment free from pollution.
dialogue.ur: Hum aisa mahol chahte hain jo aloodgi se paak ho.

dialogue.ar: هَذِهِ رِسالَةُ مُنَظَّمَتِنا، بِعَوْنِ اللهِ.
dialogue.tr: hādhihi risālatu munaẓẓamatinā, bi-ʿawni llāh
dialogue.en: This is our organization's message, with Allah's help.
dialogue.ur: Yeh hamari tanzeem ka paigham hai, Allah ki madad se.

q.en: What did Badr and his friends create?
q.ur: Badr aur saathiyon ne kya banaya?

q.en: How will they travel on the tour?
q.ur: Daure par kaise jayenge?

q.en: What is the first group doing?
q.ur: Pehla guroh kya kar raha hai?

q.en: Why does the second group plant the land?
q.ur: Doosra guroh zameen kyun ugata hai?

q.en: What is the organization's message, in the end?
q.ur: Tanzeem ka paigham aakhir mein?

intro.en: First practise the vocabulary words of the dialogue in your own sentences. Then learn the signs of nasb: the fatha, the kasra, the ya, the alif and dropping the noon.
intro.ur: Pehle sabaq ke alfaaz apne jumlon mein istemal karein. Phir nasb ki nishaniyan seekhein: fatha, kasra, ya, alif aur noon ka girna.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ أَوَّلاً عَلى كَلِماتِ الحِوارِ في جُمَلٍ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ. ثُمَّ تَعَلَّمْ عَلاماتِ النَّصْبِ: الفَتْحَةُ وَالكَسْرَةُ وَالياءُ وَالأَلِفُ وَحَذْفُ النّونِ.

q.ar: ما عَلامَةُ نَصْبِ جَمْعِ المُؤَنَّثِ السّالِمِ «طالِباتٍ»؟

q.en: The nasb sign of the five nouns, like أَباكَ, is:
q.ur: الأَسْماء الخَمْسَة (أَباكَ) ki nishani:

title.ur: Sun kar samajhna: Mausam ki tabdeeli

intro.en: Listen to a news item about the earth getting hotter. Then complete sentences about the biggest problem, deaths, migration and what rising heat may lead to. The second slide is a team activity: compare what harms and what protects the environment.
intro.ur: Zameen ke garam hone ki khabar sunein aur jumle mukammal karein. Dusri slide team ka kaam hai: mahol ko bigadne wale aur bachane wale aamal ka muqabala karein.
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى خَبَرٍ عَنِ اِرْتِفاعِ حَرارَةِ الأَرْضِ، ثُمَّ أَكْمِلْ جُمَلاً عَنْ أَكْبَرِ مُشْكِلَةٍ وَالوَفَياتِ وَالهِجْرَةِ وَما قَدْ يُؤَدّي إِلَيْهِ اِرْتِفاعُ الحَرارَةِ. وَالنَّشاطُ الثّاني جَماعِيٌّ: قارِنْ بَيْنَ ما يَضُرُّ بِالبيئَةِ وَما يَحْميها.

q.en: What is the topic of the news?
q.ur: Khabar ka mauzoo?

q.en: Which action harms the environment?
q.ur: Kaun sa amal mahol ko nuqsan deta hai?

q.en: Which action protects the environment?
q.ur: Kaun sa amal mahol ki hifazat hai?

q.en: What is the Arabic for 'change of climate'?
q.ur: 'Mausam ki tabdeeli' arabi mein?
q.ar: ما العِبارَةُ الدّالَّةُ عَلى تَغَيُّرِ المُناخِ؟

intro.en: A reading about how Islam encourages protecting the environment: planting trees and not wasting water. The book quotes the Prophet ﷺ about planting a small palm shoot. Read it with respect.
intro.ur: Ek parhai ke Islam mahol ki hifazat kaise sikhata hai: darakht lagana aur paani zaya na karna. Kitab Nabi ﷺ ki hadees naqal karti hai. Adab se parhein.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلقِراءَةِ عَنْ تَشْجيعِ الإِسْلامِ عَلى حِمايَةِ البيئَةِ: غَرْسِ الأَشْجارِ وَعَدَمِ الإِسْرافِ في الماءِ. وَيَذْكُرُ الكِتابُ حَديثَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ عَنْ غَرْسِ الفَسيلَةِ. اِقْرَأْهُ بِاحْتِرامٍ.

dialogue.ar: عَلى الإِنْسانِ أَنْ يُحافِظَ عَلى البيئَةِ الَّتي يَعيشُ فيها، وَأَلّا يُفْسِدَها؛ لِأَنَّها مِنْ أَعْظَمِ نِعَمِ اللهِ عَلى عِبادِهِ.
dialogue.tr: ʿalā l-insāni an yuḥāfiẓa ʿalā l-bīʾati llatī yaʿīshu fīhā, wa allā yufsidahā; li-annahā min aʿẓami niʿami llāhi ʿalā ʿibādih
dialogue.en: A person must protect the environment he lives in and not harm it, because it is among the greatest blessings of Allah upon His servants.
dialogue.ur: Insaan par lazim hai ke jis mahol mein rehta hai uski hifazat kare aur use na bigade, kyunke yeh Allah ki bandon par sab se bari nematon mein se hai.

dialogue.ar: وَفي كَثيرٍ مِنْ بِلادِ العالَمِ -اليَوْمَ- مُنَظَّماتٌ، تَدْعو إِلى المُحافَظَةِ عَلى البيئَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wa fī kathīrin min bilādi l-ʿālami -l-yawma- munaẓẓamāt, tadʿū ilā l-muḥāfaẓati ʿalā l-bīʾa
dialogue.en: In many countries of the world today there are organizations that call for protecting the environment.
dialogue.ur: Aaj duniya ke kai mulkon mein aisi tanzeemein hain jo mahol ki hifazat ki dawat deti hain.

dialogue.ar: وَتَقومُ تِلْكَ المُنَظَّماتُ بِأَعْمالٍ عَديدَةٍ، مِنْها: بَيانُ أَخْطارِ تَلَوُّثِ البيئَةِ عَلى الإِنْسانِ وَالحَيَوانِ وَالنَّباتِ، وَمُراقَبَةُ الحُكوماتِ وَالمُؤَسَّساتِ الَّتي تُفْسِدُ البيئَةَ، وَذِكْرُ وَسائِلِ المُحافَظَةِ عَلَيْها.
dialogue.tr: wa taqūmu tilka l-munaẓẓamātu bi-aʿmālin ʿadīda, minhā: bayānu akhṭāri talawwuthi l-bīʾati ʿalā l-insāni wa l-ḥayawāni wa n-nabāt, wa murāqabatu l-ḥukūmāti wa l-muʾassasāti llatī tufsidu l-bīʾa, wa dhikru wasāʾili l-muḥāfaẓati ʿalayhā
dialogue.en: These organizations do many things, including explaining the dangers of pollution to people, animals and plants, monitoring governments and institutions that harm the environment, and mentioning ways to protect it.
dialogue.ur: Yeh tanzeemein kai kaam karti hain, jaise: insaan, janwar aur paudhon par aloodgi ke khatre batana, mahol bigadne wali hukumaton aur idaron ki nigrani, aur hifazat ke tareeqe batana.

dialogue.ar: مِنْ وَسائِلِ المُحافَظَةِ عَلى البيئَةِ، الَّتي يَدْعو إِلَيْها الإِسْلامُ، غَرْسُ الأَشْجارِ. وَمِنَ الخَطَأِ، إِحْراقُ الغاباتِ، كَما يَحْدُثُ في بَعْضِ البِلادِ الآنَ.
dialogue.tr: min wasāʾili l-muḥāfaẓati ʿalā l-bīʾa, allatī yadʿū ilayhā l-islām, gharsu l-ashjār. wa mina l-khaṭaʾ, iḥrāqu l-ghābāt, kamā yaḥduthu fī baʿḍi l-bilādi l-ān
dialogue.en: Among the ways of protecting the environment that Islam calls to is planting trees. It is wrong to burn forests, as happens in some countries now.
dialogue.ur: Mahol ki hifazat ke tareeqon mein se, jinki taraf Islam bulata hai, darakht lagana hai. Jungle jalana ghalat hai, jaisa ke aaj kuch mulkon mein hota hai.

dialogue.ar: قالَ الرَّسولُ ﷺ: «إِنْ قامَتِ القِيامَةُ، وَفي يَدِ أَحَدِكُمْ فَسيلَةٌ (نَخْلَةٌ صَغيرَةٌ) فَإِنِ اسْتَطاعَ أَلّا تَقومَ حَتّى يَغْرِسَها، فَلْيَغْرِسْها».
dialogue.tr: qāla r-rasūlu ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam: in qāmati l-qiyāma, wa fī yadi aḥadikum fasīla (nakhlatun ṣaghīra) fa-ini staṭāʿa allā taqūma ḥattā yaghrisahā, fa-yaghrish-hā
dialogue.en: The Messenger ﷺ said: if the Hour comes while one of you holds a small palm shoot, then if he can, let him not rise until he plants it, so let him plant it.
dialogue.ur: Rasoolullah ﷺ ne farmaya: agar qiyamat qaim ho jaye aur tum mein se kisi ke haath mein khajoor ka chhota paudha ho, to agar ho sake ke utthne se pehle use laga de, to zaroor laga de.

dialogue.ar: وَيُطْلَبُ هَذا الحَديثُ مِنَ الإِنْسانِ، أَنْ يَزْرَعَ الأَرْضَ، وَيَجْعَلَها خَضْراءَ. وَهَذِهِ مِنْ أَفْضَلِ الطُّرُقِ لِلْمُحافَظَةِ عَلى البيئَةِ، وَحِمايَتِها مِنَ التَّلَوُّثِ.
dialogue.tr: wa yuṭlabu hādhā l-ḥadīthu mina l-insān, an yazraʿa l-arḍ, wa yajʿalahā khaḍrāʾ. wa hādhihi min afḍali ṭ-ṭuruqi li-l-muḥāfaẓati ʿalā l-bīʾa, wa ḥimāyatihā mina t-talawwuth
dialogue.en: This hadith asks the person to plant the land and make it green. This is among the best ways to preserve the environment and protect it from pollution.
dialogue.ur: Yeh hadees insaan se chahti hai ke zameen ugaye aur use sabz kare. Yeh mahol ki hifazat aur use aloodgi se bachane ke behtareen tareeqon mein se hai.

dialogue.ar: مِنْ وَسائِلِ المُحافَظَةِ عَلى البيئَةِ أَيْضاً، عَدَمُ الإِسْرافِ في اسْتِهْلاكِ الماءِ، وَبِخاصَّةٍ إِذا عَلِمْنا أَنَّ الماءَ العَذْبَ قَليلٌ عَلى الأَرْضِ.
dialogue.tr: min wasāʾili l-muḥāfaẓati ʿalā l-bīʾati ayḍan, ʿadamu l-isrāfi fī istihlāki l-māʾ, wa bi-khāṣṣatin idhā ʿalimnā anna l-māʾa l-ʿadhba qalīlun ʿalā l-arḍ
dialogue.en: Another way to protect the environment is not wasting water, especially when we know that fresh water is little on earth.
dialogue.ur: Mahol ki hifazat ka ek aur tareeqa paani ke istemal mein israf na karna hai, khaas kar jab hum jaante hain ke meetha paani zameen par kam hai.

dialogue.ar: وَلِأَهَمِّيَّةِ الماءِ؛ فَإِنَّ الإِسْلامَ يَنْهى عَنِ الإِسْرافِ فيهِ في كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، حَتّى في العِباداتِ.
dialogue.tr: wa li-ahammiyyati l-māʾ; fa-inna l-islāma yanhā ʿani l-isrāfi fīhi fī kulli shayʾ, ḥattā fī l-ʿibādāt
dialogue.en: Because of the importance of water, Islam forbids wasting it in everything, even in acts of worship.
dialogue.ur: Paani ki ahmiyat ki wajah se Islam har cheez mein uske israf se rokta hai, yahan tak ke ibadaat mein bhi.

q.en: Why must a person protect his environment, according to the text?
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq insaan mahol ki hifazat kyun kare?
q.ar: لِماذا يَجِبُ عَلى الإِنْسانِ أَنْ يَحْمِيَ بيئَتَهُ حَسَبَ النَّصِّ؟

options: لِأَنَّها مِنْ أَعْظَمِ نِعَمِ اللهِ عَلى عِبادِه

q.en: Which way does Islam call to?
q.ur: Islam kis cheez ki taraf bulata hai?

q.en: What is also a way to protect the environment?
q.ur: Mahol ki hifazat ka aur tareeqa?
q.ar: أَيُّ شَيْءٍ مِنْ وَسائِلِ حِمايَةِ البيئَةِ؟

q.en: What can lack of water lead to between countries?
q.ur: Paani ki kami mulkon ke darmiyan kya kar sakti hai?
q.ar: إِلامَ قَدْ يُؤَدّي نَقْصُ الماءِ بَيْنَ الدُّوَلِ؟

q.en: What does Islam say about waste, even in worship?
q.ur: Islam israf ke baare mein kya kehta hai, ibadat mein bhi?
q.ar: ما مَوْقِفُ الإِسْلامِ مِنَ الإِسْرافِ حَتّى في العِبادَةِ؟

intro.en: A present-tense verb after لَمْ or لا (the 'do not' lā) is in the 'jazm' state. Its signs: a sukoon, dropping the noon (for the five verbs), or dropping the weak letter (for verbs ending in a weak letter). Example: لا تُفْسِدوا البيئَةَ (do not harm the environment).
intro.ur: Fe'l muzari' jab لَمْ ya لا (mana karne wala) ke baad aaye to majzoom hota hai. Nishaniyan: sukoon, noon ka girna (af'al-e-khamsa mein), ya harf-e-illat ka girna (jis fe'l ke akhir mein illat ho). Misal: لا تُفْسِدوا البيئَةَ (mahol mat bigado).
intro.ar: يُجْزَمُ الفِعْلُ المُضارِعُ بَعْدَ «لَمْ» وَ«لا» النّاهِيَةِ. وَعَلاماتُ الجَزْمِ: السُّكونُ، وَحَذْفُ النّونِ في الأَفْعالِ الخَمْسَةِ، وَحَذْفُ حَرْفِ العِلَّةِ في المُعْتَلِّ الآخِرِ. مِثالٌ: لا تُفْسِدوا البيئَةَ.

q.en: The jazm sign of a regular verb like لَمْ يَلْعَبْ is:
q.ur: Aam fe'l لَمْ يَلْعَبْ ki jazm ki nishani:
q.ar: ما عَلامَةُ جَزْمِ الفِعْلِ الصَّحيحِ في «لَمْ يَلْعَبْ»؟

q.en: The jazm sign in لا تُفْسِدوا البيئَةَ is:
q.ur: لا تُفْسِدوا البيئَةَ mein jazm ki nishani:
q.ar: ما عَلامَةُ الجَزْمِ في «لا تُفْسِدوا البيئَةَ»؟

q.en: The jazm sign in لَمْ يَدْعُ صاحِبَهُ is:
q.ur: لَمْ يَدْعُ صاحِبَهُ mein jazm ki nishani:
q.ar: ما عَلامَةُ الجَزْمِ في «لَمْ يَدْعُ صاحِبَهُ»؟

q.en: Which word makes a present verb jazm to negate the past?
q.ur: Kaun sa harf muzari' ko majzoom kar ke maazi ki nafi karta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ أَداةٍ تَجْزِمُ المُضارِعَ وَتَنْفي الماضِيَ؟

q.en: In لَمْ يَفْحَصْ المَريضَ, how does the verb يَفْحَصْ end?
q.ur: لَمْ يَفْحَصْ mein fe'l ka akhir kaisa hai?
q.ar: بِمَ يَنْتَهي الفِعْلُ «يَفْحَصْ» في «لَمْ يَفْحَصِ المَريضَ»؟

intro.en: In this section you practise writing. First turn the dialogue of lesson 1 into a story, starting with a given sentence. Then write about 'Types of environmental pollution', using the reading text.
intro.ur: Is hissay mein likhne ki mashq hai. Pehle sabaq 1 ke mukaalme ko kahani mein badlein, di gayi pehli line se. Phir parhai ki madad se 'mahol ki aloodgi ki qismein' par likhein.
intro.ar: في هذا القِسْمِ تَتَدَرَّبُ عَلى الكِتابَةِ. حَوِّلْ حِوارَ الدَّرْسِ الأَوَّلِ إِلى قِصَّةٍ تَبْدَأُ بِجُمْلَةٍ مُعْطاةٍ، ثُمَّ اُكْتُبْ عَنْ «أَنْواعِ تَلَوُّثِ البيئَةِ» مُسْتَعيناً بِنَصِّ القِراءَةِ.

q.en: The starting sentence of the story is about:
q.ur: Kahani ki pehli line kis ke baare mein hai?

q.en: What is the title of the second topic?
q.ur: Doosre mauzoo ka unwan?

q.en: «سَرْدِيّ» (in the instructions) means:
q.ur: «سَرْدِيّ» ka matlab:

q.en: Which text helps with the second topic?
q.ur: Doosre mauzoo mein kaun si parhai madad karti hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ نَصٍّ يُساعِدُكَ في المَوْضوعِ الثّاني؟

intro.en: Two last skills. First, copy a line of poetry in Ruq'ah script. Then learn that some words have an alif that is pronounced but not written, such as هذا and الله.
intro.ur: Do aakhri mahaarat. Pehle ruq'ah khat mein ek shair naqal karein. Phir seekhein ke kuch alfaaz mein alif bola jata hai magar likha nahin jata, jaise هذا aur الله.
intro.ar: مَهارَتانِ أَخيرَتانِ: اُكْتُبْ بَيْتَ شِعْرٍ بِخَطِّ الرُّقْعَةِ، ثُمَّ تَعَلَّمْ أَنَّ في بَعْضِ الكَلِماتِ أَلِفاً تُنْطَقُ وَلا تُكْتَبُ، مِثْلَ «هذا» وَ«الله».

q.en: In which words is the alif pronounced but not written?
q.ur: Kin alfaaz mein alif bola jata hai magar likha nahin jata?
q.ar: في أَيِّ كَلِماتٍ أَلِفٌ تُنْطَقُ وَلا تُكْتَبُ؟

q.en: Which of these is an example from the list?
q.ur: Fehrist ki misal kaun si hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ مِنْ هذِهِ الكَلِماتِ مِثالٌ عَلى ذلِكَ؟

q.en: Which script is used for the line of poetry?
q.ur: Shair kis khat mein hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ خَطٍّ اُسْتُعْمِلَ في بَيْتِ الشِّعْرِ؟

q.en: The poem line says the ship does not sail on the...
q.ur: Shair kehta hai kashti nahin chalti...
q.ar: يَقولُ بَيْتُ الشِّعْرِ إِنَّ السَّفينَةَ لا تَجْري عَلى...
